 Replaceable cables: No [...] I’m a big fan of Sennheiser headphones and always enjoy using my Sennheiser HD380 Pros or HD6 Mix’s. I also own the highly affordable and high quality, CX 300-II in-ears.

They might not be much to look at, compared to some of the much more expensive headphones in this list, but they deliver a really great sound for a fraction of the cost.
